conditions: The language description in Stanford STAN-CS-71-230, §§5.4.1–5.4.3.
limitations: Record designator argument ordering and field initialization follow §6.7. Compiler storage layout and later ports have separate scope.

triggers: Newly available originals, corrected bibliographic or errata evidence, archive byte drift, or a contrary scoped source.

statement: The February 1972 ALGOL W Language Description defines a record class with a sequence of simple variable declarations that name and type its fields. The class identifier can be used in a record designator to construct a record of that class.
